create_journal_node: create a Node with code, plan, and metric to add to a solution tree journal
append_node_to_journal: append a new Node to a Journal and automatically assign it the next step number
get_best_node_from_journal: get the best node from a Journal based on validation metric values
export_journal_data: export a Journal to a dictionary containing all nodes and the best solution code
reconstruct_journal_from_export: reconstruct a Journal object from previously exported search data with parent-child relationships
